name: OpenVibe.Watch

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database is what ready checks)

drains: prune timers and the Network key refresher stopped
the scheduler stops starting checks and lets those in flight finish (each bounded by the fetch timeout)

resumes.what: sign-in sessions are rows in the database, so a person stays signed in across the restart
watches that fell due during the stop are checked again, oldest first, at most WATCH_MAX_CONCURRENT at a time (next_due_at and not_before are rows)
unsent watch.* events in the outbox go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop (at least once; account_data_events applies each export and deletion once)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migrations 0001-0002 only create Watch's own tables and the site's sessions; an earlier release ignores the sessions table

leases.none: no claims: one process runs the scheduler; check.run() refuses a second check of a watch in that process

notes: Port 4730, unit openvibe-watch.service. Persistent, user-defined observations and conditions over pages, feeds and APIs (plan T18): the registry, the check engine with the pull carriers (http, feed, api; conditional GET, per-host spacing, backoff, Retry-After), observations and watch.* events through a transactional outbox, the bearer API (/api/v1, loopback) and, since 0.2.0, the public site at openvibe.watch: sign in with OpenVibe (OAuth client watch, PKCE S256, sessions in Watch's database) and create, edit, pause, check and delete your watches in the browser. Event, webhook, Run and Node carriers, AI extraction and actions come in later T18 steps and are not offered. A fired condition becomes a WATCH_TRIGGERED notification through OpenVibe.Network.

site.name: Watch
site.what: Watch a page, a feed or a JSON API and get told when the value you care about changes or crosses the line you set, checked politely on your cadence.
